name: First Light
brief: Cross the Karman line. Fly a sounding rocket above 100 km altitude. A simple, cheap vertical flight: the ideal first test of your autopilot.
script_template: # Straight up. Drag costs altitude, so burn the whole tank.
print Engine cut - coasting to apogee
hint: Drag matters: a rocket that would just reach 100 km in a vacuum falls short in the atmosphere. Burn the whole tank, or build a little bigger.

name: Park in Orbit
brief: Put a satellite into a stable low Earth orbit: periapsis above 160 km, held for a minute. You need roughly 9.4 km/s of Δv in total: staging, a gravity turn and a circularisation burn at apoapsis.

objectives.label: Orbit Earth with periapsis above 160 km

script_template: pitch 80          # small kick to the east
sas prograde      # follow the flight path
stage             # drop empty stage 1, stage 2 lights
hint: Check Δv per stage in the VAB. A first stage with TWR ~1.5 and a ~90 s burn flies well; hydrolox (Swift) engines shine in the upper stages.

name: Lunar Orbiter
brief: Send a satellite to the Moon and capture it into a lunar orbit (periapsis above 20 km, apoapsis below 10,000 km, held for 5 minutes). You need ~9.4 km/s to reach LEO, ~3.1 km/s for the trans-lunar burn and ~1 km/s to be captured - and the Moon must be in the right place when you leave.

objectives.label: Orbit the Moon (Pe > 20 km, Ap < 10,000 km)

script_template: # ---- circularise in a parking orbit with the upper stage
# ---- trans-lunar injection: leave when the Moon is ~131 deg ahead of you
# ---- coast (3-5 days), then brake into lunar orbit at periapsis
hint: Open the map (M) after the burn: it shows where the Moon will be and your predicted closest approach. A 1 degree change in departure angle moves your pass by ~1000 km.

name: Touchdown
brief: Land on the Moon. Everything from Mission 3, plus a lander: kill your orbital speed, fall, and slow to under 5 m/s before you touch the surface. Landing legs are part of the Lander Probe, so it is required. Bring more Δv than you think.
script_template: # ---- circularise in a parking orbit with the upper stage
# ---- coast, then brake into lunar orbit at periapsis
# ---- powered descent: stop the orbital motion...
throttle min(1, max(0, (speed*speed/(2*max(altitude - 1, 0.5)) + gravity*0.9)/(twr*gravity)*1.05)) until landed > 0
hint: The descent script uses a closed-loop 'throttle ... until landed' controller: it computes the deceleration needed to stop exactly at the ground and sets the throttle every step.

name: Sample Return
brief: Coming in a future milestone: land, collect a sample, launch from the Moon, and re-enter Earth's atmosphere. Needs Earth rotation, re-entry heating and parachutes.
